name: iamdevroyal/nativephp-push
description: Free FCM/APNs push notifications for NativePHP Mobile — fail-closed event allow-list by default, native-side FQCN validation, defense-in-depth security model, and a fluent server-side FCM v1 sender. Requires nativephp/mobile ^3.2.

suggest.google/auth: Server-side only: required by Iamdevroyal\NativePush\Server\FcmSender to mint FCM v1 tokens. Run `composer require google/auth` on the machine that SENDS pushes.
